mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the head and spine to the trunk was most worthwhile: it showed how nerves and blood routes connect the parts into one body.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the urinary organs was clear but mostly straightforward placement into a named slot.

surprise.text: The repaired skin kept its small scar and connected to the surrounding vessels and nerves, rather than becoming the whole covering.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary. The named slots and matching routes made the placements clear, though the compatible options also guided the choices.

continue.text: Maybe. I liked seeing the separate structures come together, but the mostly straightforward fittings made me less curious about another similar chapter.
